content: When ComM_LimitChannelToNoComMode() is called, ComM module shall update the inhibition status (limitation to Specification of Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 80 of 192 Document ID 79 : AUTOSAR_SWS_COMManager COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION ) for the corresponding channel.
